sharedInterface.name: floatingSurface(FloatingOptions)
sharedInterface.mechanism: Native dialog semantics, clamped anchor positioning, open/close/toggle, z-order, ResizeObserver/window resize/document scroll, Escape/Close/focus return, menu arrows and checkbox items, explicit modal Tab containment. Nonmodal disclosures never add focus trap.
sharedInterface.cleanup: Each instance owns listeners and observer; dispose closes/removes/disconnects and fences late opens. Closed-position callbacks return immediately. Owner closes current details on invalidation; no retained editable authority.

consumers.ownership: Application retains existing command handlers/error map; CodePanel remains mounted and owns current GLSL/diagnostics/Locate. Menu caller groups buttons, supplies menu variant and size. No command rebinding or feature-name switch in shared helper.
consumers.lifetime: Application root lifetime; stable singleton controls, independent shared instances. Status close uses enabled caller fallback if matching recovery removes its trigger.

consumers.ownership: Hover registry resolves current public owner projection only. Modal full text bounded/readonly. Preference adapter remains dedicated browser-local key.140ms target dwell holds valid target while moving toward details, cancels on owner/lifecycle changes; F2 resolves document.activeElement.
consumers.lifetime: Owner invalidate and mutation/visibility/blurring fences clear active; dispose clears dwell timer, listeners, observer and both surfaces. No data read per pointermove.

consumers.ownership: Feature owns complete message and operation-kind recovery; optional public readonly platform seam avoids forbidden feature→ui import.
consumers.lifetime: PresentationSession validates containment/protocol, registers disposer in MountScope, old methods/create-after-revoke cannot reopen. No command authority passed.

primitiveReuse.sockets: nodePortRow supplies circle-only button with accessible name + separate label/type for actual/catalog rows; common port/socket CSS. Inspector has no newly invented connection control.
primitiveReuse.controls: Existing native styled buttons/select/numeric inputs remain shared. No framework dependency, full app/docking rewrite or new input-ladder semantics.

diagnosticLocate: code.ts adds per-render serial and connected-node check, excludes stale compilation location. Scope.event and existing context node lookup remain final authority. Detached callbacks cannot act on a new current projection.
limits: Read-only scout supplied concrete leads for UA menu margin and accessible toggle state; Implementer fixed and tested. This is not independent architecture PASS. Existing catalog movable window remains its own prior owner; no new movable window variant was invented.
